Predict one dataset from another

Source: R/fastcca.R
predict-fastcca-method.Rd

Using CCA fit, predict one dataset from another

Usage

# S4 method for class 'fastcca'
predict(object, X, Y, ...)

Arguments

object

model fit from fastcca()

X

first dataset

Y

second dataset

...

other arguments, not used

Details

Specify which dataset to map from using X and Y.

Examples

pop <- LifeCycleSavings[, 2:3]
oec <- LifeCycleSavings[, -(2:3)]

# fit CCA
fit <- fastcca(pop, oec)

# predict Y given X
y.pred <- predict(fit, X = pop)
head(y.pred)
#>                  sr        dpi     ddpi
#> Australia 12.320372 1483.77802 3.872615
#> Austria    9.245129 2768.15646 3.864170
#> Belgium    8.595339 2801.55334 3.845102
#> Bolivia    6.151504  717.74312 3.612932
#> Brazil    11.093935  -72.32451 3.719038
#> Canada     9.857066 1535.71414 3.794907

# predict X given Y
x.pred <- predict(fit, Y = oec)
head(x.pred)
#>              pop15     pop75
#> Australia 24.26890 3.9097999
#> Austria   29.44154 2.8931514
#> Belgium   23.81550 3.6997657
#> Bolivia   46.74744 0.9310952
#> Brazil    34.18067 1.9304995
#> Canada    22.46606 4.6495919
